name: radiantcursor-studio
description: Editor e motor multiplataforma de efeitos globais de clique e rastro
author: RadiantCursor Studio contributors

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:main && npm run typecheck:renderer
scripts.build:main: npm run typecheck:main && npm run bundle:main && npm run bundle:preload
scripts.build:renderer: npm run build:renderer:normal && npm run build:renderer:studio
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle:main && npm run bundle:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package:linux:normal: npm run build && npm run package:linux:normal:built
scripts.package:linux:studio: npm run build && npm run package:linux:studio:built
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run package:linux:normal:built && npm run package:linux:studio:built
scripts.build:runtime:windows: cmake -S native/windows -B native/windows/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build native/windows/build --config Release --parallel
scripts.package:windows:normal: npm run build:runtime:windows && npm run build && npm run package:windows:normal:built
scripts.package:windows:studio: npm run build:runtime:windows && npm run build && npm run package:windows:studio:built
scripts.package:windows: npm run build:runtime:windows && npm run build && npm run package:windows:normal:built && npm run package:windows:studio:built
